  "summary": "Adds a functional test verifying that active manual outbound connections created through the addnode RPC are capped at MAX_ADDNODE_CONNECTIONS (8). The test adds 9 reachable nodes, checks that getaddednodeinfo tracks all 9 entries, and confirms that getpeerinfo and getnetworkinfo show no more than 8 active connections over a stability period.",

result.card: Adds a functional test covering the MAX_ADDNODE_CONNECTIONS limit (8) for manual outbound connections created via the addnode RPC. It addresses a gap identified in issue #28635, where the behavior of adding more nodes than the manual outbound cap was untested. The test adds 9 reachable target nodes and verifies that all 9 are tracked while active connections remain strictly capped at 8.
